Sun & Moon series · HIF

Hidden Fates

Released August 23, 2019 · 69 cards

Expanded

Hidden Fates is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on August 23, 2019. Its main set has 68 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (69 in total). It includes 52 Pokémon, 17 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

37 illustrators worked on Hidden Fates. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (8), Megumi Mizutani (8), Ken Sugimori (5), TOKIYA (4), Masakazu Fukuda (3), aky CG Works (2), Hasuno (2), Hideki Ishikawa (2).
